captions.detailed: An automatic parking lot barrier gate featuring a grey rectangular steel post housing with a black base plate and top hardware. A long, light-grey horizontal boom arm with orange reflective safety stripes is mounted to a black pivot hinge block. The arm is balanced by a black counterweight block on its short tail and terminates in a black rubber end cap. The boom arm rotates upward around a transverse horizontal axis to allow vehicle passage.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an automatic parking lot barrier gate. The model should include a vertical grey support post with a black base, a black top hinge assembly, and a long, light-grey rectangular boom arm with orange reflective stripes, a black end cap, and a black counterweight block that pivots on a horizontal hinge.
captions.factory: Construct the main post using a vertical Box primitive, adding a thin, wider Box at the bottom for the base plate and a small cap Box at the top. Create the pivot assembly using a horizontal Cylinder for the hinge pin and a bracket from a Box. Build the boom arm by extruding a long, thin rectangular profile, adding small, thin colored Box primitives along its length for the reflective stripes, a Box at the tip for the end cap, and a heavy Box at the short end for the counterweight. Define a revolute joint connecting the boom arm assembly to the hinge pin on the post.
